meta.name: hivemind-graph
meta.description: Query the local code graph (functions, classes, calls, imports) through the Deeplake mount at memory/graph/. Use when the user asks structural questions about the codebase — "what calls X?", "what does Y import?", "where is Z defined?", "what's the architecture / which subsystems exist?", "what's the impact of changing this?". The graph is an AST-derived map of the repo, queried as files (no build needed — it rebuilds automatically).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询代码库的结构、调用关系和依赖
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解代码库结构和调用关系
copy.tagline_en: Query code structure, calls, and dependencies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand codebase structure and call relationships

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能查询代码的抽象语法树图，包括函数、类、调用、导入等关系。它通过读取 Deeplake 挂载下的合成文件来回答代码结构问题，无需手动构建，自动刷新。
howto.when: 当用户询问代码的结构或关系问题，比如“谁调用了这个函数”、“这个文件导入什么”、“哪里定义了某个类”时触发。

say.note: 返回调用该函数的位置和调用者。
列出文件的所有导入依赖。

say.text: 项目有哪些主要子系统？
say.note: 展示架构分层和子系统列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query the AST-derived code graph (functions, classes, calls, imports) via Deeplake-mounted synthetic files. It answers structural questions automatically without manual builds.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks structural/relational questions about the codebase, e.g., "Who calls X?", "What does Y import?", "Where is Z defined?".

say_en.note: Lists all imports of the file.
Shows architecture layers and subsystem list.
